units.en: When the civil war fires, chose the option for divisions, rather than territory and do the Mobilize the Veteran Legionaries focus ASAP. When you attack Argentina DO NOT finish the war, but try to push a bit in the south and cause some casualties. When WW2 starts, attack France and join Axis. If Germany doesn't let you join, reload the save and they will let you. Once France capitulates, just ask Germany for control of Paris. (You should have enough war score from the war against Argentina). If it still is not enough, try giving Germany some of the occupied territories in Argentina.
True Condor LegionAs CHL, BOL, PRU, ECU, VEN, COL - Sent volunteers to Germany
Playing as ⟦0⟧: Bolivia Chile Colombia Ecuador Peru Venezuela
Bolivia Chile Colombia Ecuador Peru Venezuela

Picking a country that already starts with an authoritarian government like Venezuela or Peru can speed things up. Spam 2-width divisions to reach the threshold for sending volunteers (30) and when Germany attacks Poland on historical, simply send a few volunteers. If world tension is too low justify a war goal on the USA to spike it.

Argentina: Go the fascist path down to "Union Nacional Fascista" and build up your industry and a capable army. Get military access from Italy or even join the Axis via focus. Either way naval invade Spain when their civil war is over and your army is ready. They'll have very few equipment but will try to conquer any bridgehead you establish. This will cause them to have a massive equipment deficit quickly so you can overrun them easily. (Naval invading from countries you only have military access to works when you first set up a naval invasion from your country to the point from where you want to naval invade your actual target. For example set up from Buenos Aires to Sardinia and then you should be able to plan from Sardinia).
Hispanics of the world, unite!As Chile, form the Hispanic Alliance and have at least 8 "Hispanic" nations in your faction

Has completed focus The Hispanic Alliance Is Faction leader Has at least 8 of the following countries in your faction: Mexico Guatemala Cuba Dominican Republic Puerto Rico El Salvador Honduras Nicaragua Costa Rica Panama Colombia Venezuela Ecuador Peru Bolivia Paraguay Uruguay Argentina
Has at least 8 of the following countries in your faction:

Rush down the fascist route and take the Hispanic Alliance focus to invite all fascist or non-aligned Hispanic American countries. There is an 80% chance for them to accept your invitation (independent of opinion or diplomatic pressure). In 1936, these countries are Argentina, Dominican Republic, El Salvador, Guatemala, Nicaragua, Peru, Uruguay and Venezuela, with Bolivia and Paraguay potentially flipping later. NOTE: make sure to take the focus when as many of them as possible are eligible, because it's a one-time thing; once the focus event fires, short of conquering them, it becomes extremely difficult to add anyone who refused or was ineligible at the time. Unless they are in a war, they'll need 30% fascist support, fascist government, +100 opinion, 100% diplomatic pressure, and some special factor like having a border with you, to make them accept.

Play as Argentina on historical. Go down the fascist side of the focus tree and pick the focus Establishing a Foothold to get a wargoal on Uruguay. Simply defeat and puppet them in the peace deal that follows. Once you reach 60% fascism popularity, continue down the focus tree and either create your own faction (Argentina First) or join the Axis. Near the bottom of the fascist tree you'll find the focus The Old Enemy giving you a war goal on Brazil. Once you declare your war the achievement will unlock.
